label: SYNTHETIC - bank-verifier probe plan, simulated services only
base: valid bank_a package for rfc-0001-01: canonical case 1 payout record signed by the mock merchant key, package signed by the Alibi demo key
outcomes: accepted | refused | error; a missing route or a crash is error, never refused

steps.assert: receipt binds package_id and sha256 digest of the received bytes; trust and claim statuses reported separately and unchanged

steps.build: the exact bytes of sp32-valid again
steps.assert: original receipt returned (created false); inbox lists the package once

steps.build: correctly signed package with the SAME package_id as sp32-valid and a different body (issued_at + 1s)
BASE with a fresh package_id; after signing, change one character of claims[0].rationale and re-serialise with JCS
BASE with a fresh package_id; change one character of the package signature value in the raw bytes
BASE with a fresh package_id (audience bank_a), delivered into bank_b's inbox
BASE with a fresh package_id and expires_at 1 minute after issued_at; delivered at expires_at + 1s
BASE signed by a fresh Ed25519 key with key_id alibi-rogue-1, not in the pinned registry
BASE signed in the package domain by the mock merchant key under its pinned issuer-record key_id
BASE whose issuer_verified payout record has amount_minor changed after the merchant signed it; package signed correctly
BASE whose issuer_verified payout record carries no signature
BASE with a fresh package_id plus one self_supplied attachment that has no issuer signature
steps.assert: that attachment reports trust self_supplied, attested by the package signer; the issuer record stays issuer_verified

checks.expect: receipt {package_id, recipient, request_id, digest, received_at} with digest = sha256 of the delivered bytes
bank_a lists exactly the packages from accepted steps; bank_b lists none (the SP-26 attempt stored nothing)
